improved_curse_of_agony.name: Improved Curse of Agony
improved_curse_of_agony.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Curse of Agony by [V1]%.

suppression.name: Suppression
suppression.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with spells by [V1]%, and reduces the mana cost of your Affliction spells by [V2]%.

improved_corruption.name: Improved Corruption
improved_corruption.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Corruption by [V1]%, and increases the critical strike chance of your Seed of Corruption by [V2]%.

improved_curse_of_weakness.name: Improved Curse of Weakness
improved_curse_of_weakness.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of attack power reduced by your Curse of Weakness by [V1]%.

improved_drain_soul.name: Improved Drain Soul
improved_drain_soul.tooltipTemplate: Returns [V1]% of your maximum mana if the target is killed by you while you drain its soul. In addition, your Affliction spells generate [V2]% less threat.

improved_life_tap.name: Improved Life Tap
improved_life_tap.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of Mana awarded by your Life Tap spell by [V1]%.

soul_siphon.name: Soul Siphon
soul_siphon.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life and Drain Soul spells by an additional [V1]% for each of your Affliction effects on the target, up to a maximum of [V2]% additional effect.

improved_fear.name: Improved Fear
improved_fear.tooltipTemplate: Causes your Fear spell to inflict a Nightmare on the target when the fear effect ends. The Nightmare effect reduces the target's movement speed by [V1]% for 5 sec.

fel_concentration.name: Fel Concentration
fel_concentration.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Drain Life, Drain Mana, Drain Soul, Unstable Affliction, and Haunt by [V1]%.

amplify_curse.name: Amplify Curse
amplify_curse.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the global cooldown of your Curses by 0.5 sec.

grim_reach.name: Grim Reach
grim_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Affliction spells by [V1]%.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.tooltipTemplate:
Gives your Corruption and Drain Life spells a [V1]% chance to cause you to enter a Shadow Trance state after damaging the opponent. The Shadow Trance state reduces the casting time of your next Shadow Bolt spell by 100%.

This chance increases by an additional [V1]% every time Shadow Trance does not trigger.

empowered_corruption.name: Empowered Corruption
empowered_corruption.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of your Corruption spell by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell power.

shadow_embrace.name: Shadow Embrace
shadow_embrace.tooltipTemplate: Your Shadow Bolt and Haunt spells apply the Shadow Embrace effect, increasing all shadow periodic damage dealt to the target by you by [V1]%, and reduces all periodic healing done to the target by [V2]%. Lasts for 12 sec. Stacks up to 3 times.

siphon_life.name: Siphon Life
siphon_life.tooltipTemplate: When you deal damage with your Corruption spell, you are instantly healed for 40% of the damage done. In addition, the damage done by your Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction damage over time effects is increased by 5%.

curse_of_exhaustion.name: Curse of Exhaustion
curse_of_exhaustion.tooltipTemplate:
6% of base mana
Instant cast

Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

improved_felhunter.name: Improved Felhunter
improved_felhunter.tooltipTemplate: Your Felhunter regains [V1]% of its maximum mana each time it hits with its Shadow Bite ability and the cooldown on that ability is reduced by [V2] sec. In addition, increases the effect of your Felhunter's Fel Intelligence by [V3]%.

shadow_mastery.name: Shadow Mastery
shadow_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage dealt or life drained by your Shadow spells and your Felhunter's Shadow Bite ability by [V1]%.

eradication.name: Eradication
eradication.tooltipTemplate: When you deal damage with Corruption, you have 6% chance to increase your spell casting speed by [V1]% for 10 sec.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage of Curse of Agony, Corruption and Seed of Corruption by [V1]% and reduces the chance your helpful Affliction spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by an additional [V2]%.

dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
dark_pact.tooltipTemplate:
Instant cast
Drains 305+SP*0.96 of your summoned demon's Mana, returning 100% to you.

improved_howl_of_terror.name: Improved Howl of Terror
improved_howl_of_terror.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Howl of Terror spell by [V1] sec.

malediction.name: Malediction
malediction.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell damage by [V1]%, increases the periodic critical strike chance of your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells by [V2]%, and makes your Curse of the Elements increase magic damage taken by an additional [V1]%.

deaths_embrace.name: Death's Embrace
deaths_embrace.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount drained by your Drain Life by [V1]% while your health is at or below 20% health, and increases the damage done by your Shadow spells by [V2]% when your target is at or below 35% health.

unstable_affliction.name: Unstable Affliction
unstable_affliction.tooltipTemplate:
15% of base mana
1.5 sec cast
Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing 640 damage over 15 sec. In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause $*11.25;s1 damage to the dispeller and silence them for 5 sec. Only one Unstable Affliction or Immolate per Warlock can be active on any one target.

pandemic.name: Pandemic
pandemic.tooltipTemplate: Grants the periodic damage from your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells the ability to critically hit for 100% increased damage, and increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Haunt spell by 100%.

everlasting_affliction.name: Everlasting Affliction
everlasting_affliction.tooltipTemplate: Your Corruption and Unstable Affliction spells gain an additional [V1]% of your bonus spell damage, and your Drain Life, Drain Soul, Shadow Bolt, and Haunt spells have a [V2]% chance to reset the duration of your Corruption spell on the target.

haunt.name: Haunt
haunt.tooltipTemplate:
12% of base mana
1.5 sec cast        8 sec cooldown
You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing 405 to 473 Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec. When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage it did to the target.

improved_healthstone.name: Improved Healthstone
improved_healthstone.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of Health restored by your Healthstone by [V1]%.

improved_imp.name: Improved Imp
improved_imp.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Imp's Firebolt, Fire Shield, and Blood Pact spells by [V1]%.

fel_synergy.name: Fel Synergy
fel_synergy.tooltipTemplate: You have a [V1]% chance to heal your pet for 15% of the amount of spell damage done by you.

improved_health_funnel.name: Improved Health Funnel
improved_health_funnel.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of Health transferred by your Health Funnel spell by [V1]% and reduces the health cost by [V1]%. In addition, your summoned Demon takes [V2]% less damage while under the effect of your Health Funnel.

demonic_brutality.name: Demonic Brutality
demonic_brutality.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your Voidwalker's Torment, Consume Shadows, Sacrifice and Suffering spells by [V1]%, and increases the attack power bonus on your Felguard's Demonic Frenzy effect by [V2]%.

fel_vitality.name: Fel Vitality
fel_vitality.tooltipTemplate: Increases the Stamina and Intellect of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard by [V1]% and increases your maximum health and mana by [V2]%.

dark_fixation.name: Dark Fixation
dark_fixation.tooltipTemplate:
Requires: Dark Apotheosis
Increases your armor by [V1]% of your spell power. Damage dealt to yourself with Life Tap is converted into an absorb shield equal to [V2]% of the self-inflicted damage.

improved_succubus.name: Improved Succubus
improved_succubus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Succubus' Seduction by [V1]%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by [V2]%.

soul_link.name: Soul Link
soul_link.tooltipTemplate:
Soul Link
16% of base mana
Instant cast

When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter, Felguard, or enslaved demon instead. That damage cannot be prevented. Lasts as long as the demon is active and controlled.

fel_domination.name: Fel Domination
fel_domination.tooltipTemplate:
Fel Domination
Instant cast	3 min cooldown
Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter or Felguard Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

demonic_aegis.name: Demonic Aegis
demonic_aegis.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your Demon Armor, Summoner's Armor and Fel Armor spells by [V1]%.

unholy_power.name: Unholy Power
unholy_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Felguard's melee attacks and your Imp's Firebolt by [V1]%.

master_summoner.name: Master Summoner
master_summoner.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter and Fel Guard Summoning spells by [V1] sec and the Mana cost by [V2]%.

mana_feed.name: Mana Feed
mana_feed.tooltipTemplate:
Instant
When you gain mana from Drain Mana or Life Tap spells, your summoned demon gains 100% of the mana you gain.

master_conjuror.name: Master Conjuror
master_conjuror.tooltipTemplate: Increases the combat ratings gained from your conjured Firestone and Spellstone by [V1]%.

taste_for_torment.name: Taste for Torment
taste_for_torment.tooltipTemplate:
Requires: Dark Apotheosis
Soul Gorge’s healing is increased by up to [V1]% of damage taken in the last 5 seconds. Searing Pain has a [V1]% chance to reset the cooldown of Soul Gorge.

master_demonologist.name: Master Demonologist
master_demonologist.tooltipTemplate:
Grants both the Warlock and the summoned demon an effect as long as that demon is active.

Imp - Increases your Fire damage by [V1]%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Fire spells by [V1]%.

Voidwalker - Reduces Physical damage taken by [V2]%.

Succubus - Increases your Shadow damage by [V1]%, and increases the critical effect chance of your Shadow spells by [V1]%.

Felhunter - Reduces all spell damage taken by [V2]%.

Felguard - Increases all damage done by [V1]%, and reduces all damage taken by [V1]%.

Enslaved Demons - Increases all damage done by [V1]%, and reduces all damage taken by [V1]%.

molten_core.name: Molten Core
molten_core.tooltipTemplate:
Increases the duration of your Immolate by 3 sec, and you have a [V1]% chance to gain the Molten Core effect when your Corruption deals damage. The Molten Core effect empowers your next 3 Incinerate or Soul Fire spells cast within 15 sec.

Incinerate - Increases damage done by [V2]% and reduces cast time by [V3]%.

Soul Fire - Increases damage done by [V2]% and increases critical strike chance by [V1]%.

demonic_resilience.name: Demonic Resilience
demonic_resilience.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee and spells by [V1]% and reduces all damage your summoned demon takes by [V2]%.

demonic_empowerment.name: Demonic Empowerment
demonic_empowerment.tooltipTemplate:
6% of base mana
Instant cast        1 min cooldown
Grants the Warlock's summoned demon Empowerment.

Imp - Increases the Imp's spell critical strike chance by 20% for 30 sec.

Voidwalker - Increases the Voidwalker's health by 20%, and its threat generated from spells and attacks by 20% for 20 sec.

Succubus - Instantly vanishes, causing the Succubus to go into an improved Invisibility state. The vanish effect removes all stuns, snares and movement impairing effects from the Succubus.

Felhunter - Dispels all magical effects from the Felhunter.

Felguard - Increases the Felguard's attack speed by 20% and breaks all stun, snare and movement impairing effects and makes your Felguard immune to them for 15 sec.

demonic_knowledge.name: Demonic Knowledge
demonic_knowledge.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell damage by an amount equal to [V1]% of the total of your active demon's Stamina plus Intellect.

demonic_tactics.name: Demonic Tactics
demonic_tactics.tooltipTemplate: Increases melee and spell critical strike chance for you and your summoned demon by [V1]%.

decimation.name: Decimation
decimation.tooltipTemplate: When you Shadow Bolt, Incinerate or Soul Fire a target that is at or below 35% health, the cast time of Soul Fire spell is reduced by [V1]% for 10 sec. Soul Fires cast under the effect of Decimation cost no shard.

improved_demonic_tactics.name: Improved Demonic Tactics
improved_demonic_tactics.tooltipTemplate:
Increases the critical strike chance of your summoned demon by an amount equal to [V1]% of your spell critical strike chance.

Additionally, when your pet is below 20% health, the damage it takes from your Soul Link is reduced by 30%.

summon_felguard.name: Summon Felguard
summon_felguard.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

nemesis.name: Nemesis
nemesis.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Demonic Empowerment, Metamorphosis, Fel Domination and Reign of Dread spells by [V1]%.

demonic_pact.name: Demonic Pact
demonic_pact.tooltipTemplate: Increases your spell damage by [V1]%, and your pet's criticals apply the Demonic Pact effect to yourself, party and raid members. Demonic Pact increases spell power by [V1]% of your Spell Damage for 45 sec. This effect has a 20 sec cooldown. Does not work on Enslaved demons.

metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
metamorphosis.tooltipTemplate:
Metamorphosis
Instant
You transform into a Demon for 30 sec. This form increases your armor by 600%, damage by 20%, reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%. You gain some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities. 3 minute cooldown.

reign_of_dread.name: Reign of Dread
reign_of_dread.tooltipTemplate:
15% of base mana
Channeled        1 min cooldown
Requires: Dark Apotheosis
Surge into the air and scorch all enemies below with 1590 Shadowflame damage over 2 sec.

While airborne, melee attacks against you have 60% increased chance to miss.

improved_shadow_bolt.name: Improved Shadow Bolt
improved_shadow_bolt.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Shadow Bolt spell by [V1]%, and your Shadow Bolt has a [V2]% chance to cause your target to be vulnerable to spell damage, increasing spell critical strike chance against that target by 5%. Effect lasts 30 sec.

bane.name: Bane
bane.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Shadow Bolt. Chaos Bolt and Immolate spells by [V1] sec and your Soul Fire spell by [V2] sec.

aftermath.name: Aftermath
aftermath.tooltipTemplate: Increases the periodic damage done by your Immolate by [V1]%, and your Conflagrate has a [V2]% chance to daze the target for 5 sec.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Destruction spells by [V1]%.

demonic_power.name: Demonic Power
demonic_power.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Succubus' Lash of Pain spell by [V1] sec. and reduces the casting time of your Imp's Firebolt spell by [V2] sec.

shadowburn.name: Shadowburn
shadowburn.tooltipTemplate:
20% of base mana
Instant cast	15 sec cooldown
Reagents:
Soul Shard

Instantly blasts the target for 104 to 116 Shadowflame damage. If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Destruction spells and your Imp's Firebolt spell by [V1]%.

intensity.name: Intensity
intensity.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting or channeling any Destruction spell by [V1]%.

destructive_reach.name: Destructive Reach
destructive_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Destruction spells by [V1]% and reduces threat caused by Destruction spells by [V1]%.

improved_searing_pain.name: Improved Searing Pain
improved_searing_pain.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Searing Pain spell by [V1]%.

backlash.name: Backlash
backlash.tooltipTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance with spells by an additional [V1]% and gives you a [V2]% chance when hit by a physical attack to reduce the cast time of your next Shadow Bolt or Incinerate spell by 100%. This effect lasts 8 sec and will not occur more than once every 8 seconds.

improved_immolate.name: Improved Immolate
improved_immolate.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Immolate spell by [V1]%.

devastation.name: Devastation
devastation.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 5%.

nether_protection.name: Nether Protection
nether_protection.tooltipTemplate: After being hit with a spell, you have a [V1]% chance to gain Nether Protection, reducing all damage by that spell school by 30% for 8 sec.

emberstorm.name: Emberstorm
emberstorm.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire and Shadow spells by [V1]% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by [V2] sec.

conflagrate.name: Conflagrate
conflagrate.tooltipTemplate:
16% of base mana
Instant cast        10 sec cooldown
Consumes an Immolate or Shadowflame effect on the enemy target to instantly deal damage equal to 60% of your Immolate or Shadowflame, and causes an additional 40% damage over until cancelled.

soul_leech.name: Soul Leech
soul_leech.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Chaos Bolt, Soul Fire, Incinerate, Searing Pain and Conflagrate spells a [V1]% chance to return health equal to 20% of the damage caused.

pyroclasm.name: Pyroclasm
pyroclasm.tooltipTemplate: When you critically strike with Searing Pain or Conflagrate, your Fire and Shadow spell damage is increased by [V1]% for 10 sec.

shadow_and_flame.name: Shadow and Flame
shadow_and_flame.tooltipTemplate: Your Shadow Bolt, Shadowburn, Chaos Bolt and Incinerate spells gain an additional [V1]% of your bonus spell damage effects.

improved_soul_leech.name: Improved Soul Leech
improved_soul_leech.tooltipTemplate: Your Soul Leech effect also restores mana to you and your summoned demon equal to [V1]% of maximum mana, and has a [V2]% chance to grant up to 10 party or raid members mana regeneration equal to 1% of maximum mana per 5 sec. Lasts for 15 sec.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.tooltipTemplate: When you cast Conflagrate, the cast time and global cooldown of your next three Destruction spells is reduced by [V1]%. Lasts 15 sec.

shadowfury.name: Shadowfury
shadowfury.tooltipTemplate:
27% of base mana
Instant cast	20 sec cooldown
Shadowfury is unleashed, causing 343 to 407 Shadow damage and stunning all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

empowered_imp.name: Empowered Imp
empowered_imp.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Imp's Firebolt by [V1]%, and all critical hits done by your Imp have a [V2]% chance to increase your spell critical hit chance for your next spell by 100%. This effect lasts 8 sec.

fire_and_brimstone.name: Fire and Brimstone
fire_and_brimstone.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Incinerate and Chaos Bolt spells to targets afflicted by your Immolate by [V1]%, and the critical strike chance of your Conflagrate spell is increased by [V2]%.

chaos_bolt.name: Chaos Bolt
chaos_bolt.tooltipTemplate:
7% of base mana
2.5 sec cast        12 sec cooldown
Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing 870 to 1049 Shadowflame damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption effects.

enchants.name: Destruction Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Fire and Shadow damage done by 4% and the damage of your Immolate by an additional 5%.

enchants.name: Demonology Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases the damage done by your summoned demon by 10% and its attack speed by 10%.

enchants.name: Affliction Mastery
enchants.tooltip: Increases your spell haste by 4% and the damage of your Corruption by 6%.

enchants.name: Feeding the Abyss
enchants.tooltip:
Your ability to Dodge is replaced with a dark hunger. You have a chance to fully absorb incoming physical damage, storing it for later use. After 10 seconds the stored damage is fed to the abyss, causing your next Life Tap to deal damage to nearby enemies, healing you and your pet based on the damage dealt.

The chance for the absorb to trigger is equal to 10% plus your spell critical strike chance.

enchants.name: Bane of Havoc
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Bane of Havoc.

Bane of Havoc
8% of base mana
Instant        35 sec cooldown
Curses the ground with a demonic bane, causing your Shadow Bolt, Incinerate, Soul Fire and Chaos Bolt spells to also strike targets marked with the bane for 50% of the damage dealt and have 15% increased critical strike chance. Lasts 15 sec.

enchants.name: Nether Portal
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Nether Portal.

Nether Portal
Instant	2 min cooldown
Tear open a portal to the Twisting Nether for 30 sec. Casting Shadow Bolt, Soul Fire or Incinerate summons a demon to fight for you. During Decimation your Soul Fire summons an additional demon.

enchants.name: Soul Erosion
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Unstable Affliction and Curse of Agony has a 8% chance to increase the damage of your next Drain Soul by 300% (500% if the target is below 25% health). Drain Soul cast this way only lasts for 6 sec but is impervious to spell pushback.

In addition, using Drain Soul the duration of your Haunt, Unstable Affliction, and Shadow Embrace is not reduced on the target.

enchants.name: Cataclysmic Burst
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Incinerate extends the duration of your Immolate by 2 seconds and increases the periodic damage of Immolate by 10%, stacking up to 4 times. This effect is consumed when casting Conflagrate.

enchants.name: Soul Harvest
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Soul Harvest.

Soul Harvest
Instant cast        2 min cooldown
Reagents:
Soul Shard

Increases your magic damage and your pets' damage by 15%. Lasts 6 sec, increased by 3 sec for each target afflicted by your Corruption, Curse of Agony and Immolate up to a maximum of 24 sec.

Does not stack with other similar effects.

enchants.name: Enslave Demon
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you how to permanently Enslave Demons.

Enslave Demon
48% of base mana
Channeled
Teaches you the necessary abilities to Enslave a Demon companion.

Teaches you Enslave Demon, Summon Demon, Dismiss Demon, Revive Demon and Demon Lore.
 Enslave Demon
Begins enslaving a demon to be your companion.

Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the demon for 20 sec.

If you lose the demon's attention for any reason, the enslaving process will fail. Each type of demon has unique abilities that you will be able to make use of.

enchants.name: Hand of Gul'dan
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Hand of Gul'dan.

Hand of Gul'dan
12% of base mana
2 sec cast        30 sec cooldown
Calls down a demonic meteor dealing 299*$+SP*0.36 Shadowflame damage to enemies within 5 yards and summons 4 Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target for 12 sec.

enchants.name: Crazy Cultist
enchants.tooltip: Your damaging Warlock spell casts have a 15% chance to cast an additional random Warlock spell for free.

enchants.name: Endless Agony
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Curse of Agony applies Endless Agony.

Dealing damage with Drain Life reduces the active duration and cooldown of your Curse of Doom by 3 sec.

After a target of your Curse of Agony dies, any stacks of Endless Agony will be spread to nearby enemies within 10 yards.

 Endless Agony
Increases your damage dealt to the target with Curse of Agony by 4% and Curse of Doom by 7%. Stacks up to 20 times and lasts for 12 sec.

enchants.name: Demonic Reoccurence
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cooldown of Metamorphosis by 75 sec, but reduces the bonus armor granted by 50% and you no longer benefit from the reduced chance to be crit or reduced duration of stuns and snares.

enchants.name: Shadow Crash
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Shadow Crash.

Shadow Crash        Rank 1
11% of base mana
Instant cast        30 sec cooldown
Hurl a bolt of slow-moving Shadow energy at the destination, dealing Shadow damage to enemies within 8 yards, pulling them towards the center of the explosion and slowing them by 70% for 3 sec.

enchants.name: Unending Resolve
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Unending Resolve.

Unending Resolve
8% of base mana
Instant        2 min cooldown
Hardens your skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.

(60% while in Dark Apotheosis)

enchants.name: Blood Horror
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Blood Horror.

Blood Horror        Rank 3
8% of base mana
Channeled        40 sec cooldown
While channeling, encases yourself in a barrier of blood, making you immune to silence, stun and interrupt effects. Any time an enemy within 25 yards deals non-periodic damage to you, you drain their health and cause them to run in horror for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Demonic Leap
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Demonic Leap.

Demonic Leap
5% of base mana
Instant        40 sec cooldown
Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.

enchants.name: Soul Swap
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Soul Swap.

Soul Swap
6% of base mana
Instant        25 sec cooldown
You copy your Corruption, Curse of Agony and Unstable Affliction effects from the target.

For 5 sec afterwards, the next target you cast Soul Swap: Exhale on will be afflicted by the copied damage-over-time effects.

You cannot Soul Swap to the same target.

enchants.name: Burning Rush
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Burning Rush.

 Burning Rush
Drains 3% of your maximum health per second to increase your movement speed by 50%. Movement-impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until cancelled.

enchants.name: Searing Brand
enchants.tooltip:
Your Searing Pain reduces the targets attack power by (151+0). This does not stack with other similar effects.

Branding a target deals additional high-threat Fire damage, this can only occur once every 15 seconds per target.

enchants.name: Demonic Whirl
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Shadow Bolt or Incinerate causes your Felguard to cast a Whirlwind, dealing damage to enemies within 8 yards.

This can only occur once every 3 sec.

enchants.name: Eternal Torment
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Haunt on a target already affected by your Haunt makes it guaranteed to critically strike. Your Haunt increases the damage of your Shadow damage-over-time effects by an additional 7%.

Your Soul Swap: Exhale can now be cast to apply your DoTs on two targets.

enchants.name: Agonizing Coil
enchants.tooltip:
Using Death Coil applies Curse of Agony on the target and harvests their essence, granting you 10% increased chance to critically strike with spells for 15 sec.

The cooldown of Death Coil is reduced by 90 sec, however it no longer causes the target to run in horror.

enchants.name: Dread Communion
enchants.tooltip: Your demon is healed for 25% of the healing you receive. Casting Demonic Empowerment triples the effect of your Master Demonologist talent for 10 seconds.

enchants.name: Doomcaller's Wrath
enchants.tooltip:
Using Curse of Doom grants you Eradication.

Duration of Eradication is increased by 5 seconds.

Increases the damage of Curse of Doom by 30%.

enchants.name: Searing Flames
enchants.tooltip:
The periodic effect of Immolate now deals damage to all enemies within 8 yards of the target, but can only be active on one target at a time.

Each time Immolate deals periodic damage, your Imp's Firebolt critical strike chance increases by 3%, consumed when it critically hits.

enchants.name: Shadow Siphon

abilities.name: Corruption
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Corrupts the target, causing [V1] Shadow damage over [V2] sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Agony
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the target with agony, causing [V1] Shadow damage over 24 sec. This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Curse reaches its full duration. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Doom
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the target with impending doom, causing [V1] Shadow damage after 1 min. If the target yields experience or honor when it dies from this damage, a Doomguard will be summoned. Cannot be cast on players.

abilities.name: Curse of the Elements
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Arcane, Fire, Frost, Nature, and Shadow resistances by [V1] and increasing magic damage taken by [V2]%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Tongues
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by [V1]%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target. Lasts 30 sec.

abilities.name: Curse of Weakness
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Target's melee attack power is reduced by [V1] and armor is reduced by 5% for 2 min. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Death Coil
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Causes the enemy target to run in horror for 3 sec and causes [V1] Shadow damage. The caster gains 300% of the damage caused in health.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Transfers [V1] health every 1 sec from the target to the caster. Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Drain Mana
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Transfers 3% of target's maximum mana every 1 sec from the target to the caster (up to a maximum of 6% of the caster's maximum mana every 1 sec). Lasts 5 sec.

abilities.name: Drain Soul
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Drains the soul of the target dealing [V1] Shadow damage over 15 sec. Deals Four times damage to targets at or below 25% health.

If the target dies while being drained, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard. Each time the Drain Soul damages the target, it also has a chance to generate a Soul Shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.

Deals three times damage to players.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Strikes fear in the enemy, causing it to run in fear for up to [V1] sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

abilities.name: Howl of Terror
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Howl, causing 5 enemies within 10 yds to flee in terror for [V1] sec. Damage caused may interrupt the effect.

abilities.name: Life Tap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Converts [V1] health into [V2] mana. Spell power increases the amount of mana returned.

abilities.name: Seed of Corruption
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Imbeds a demon seed in the enemy target, causing [V1] Shadow damage over 18 sec. When the target takes [V2] total damage or dies, the seed will inflict [V3] to [V4] Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards of the target. Only one Corruption spell per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Curse of Exhaustion
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the target's movement speed by 30% for 12 sec. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.

abilities.name: Dark Pact
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Drains [V1] of your summoned demon's Mana, returning 100% to you.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You send a ghostly soul into the target, dealing [V1] to [V2] Shadow damage and increasing all damage done by your Shadow damage-over-time effects on the target by 20% for 12 sec. When the Haunt spell ends or is dispelled, the soul returns to you, healing you for 100% of the damage it did to the target.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When you deal damage with your Corruption spell, you are instantly healed for 40% of the damage done. In addition, the damage done by your Corruption, Seed of Corruption and Unstable Affliction damage over time effects is increased by 5%.

abilities.name: Unstable Affliction
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shadow energy slowly destroys the target, causing [V1] damage over 15 sec. In addition, if the Unstable Affliction is dispelled it will cause $*11.25;s1 damage to the dispeller and silence them for 5 sec. Only one Unstable Affliction or Immolate per Warlock can be active on any one target.

You copy your Corruption, Curse of Agony and Unstable Affliction effects from the target.

For 5 sec afterwards, the next target you cast Soul Swap: Exhale on will be afflicted by the copied damage-over-time effects.

You cannot Soul Swap to the same target.

abilities.tooltipTemplate: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to [V1] sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Casting Banish on a banished target will cancel the spell. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

abilities.name: Unending Breath
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Allows the target to breathe underwater for 10 min.

abilities.name: Maw of Dread
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires
Releases a demonic howl in a wide cone before you, causing [V1] Shadow damage to enemies caught within and slowing their attacks by 20% for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Provoke
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires
Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

This spell can not miss.

abilities.name: Soul Gorge
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires
Hurls demonic ruin at up to five enemies, causing [V1] Shadow damage. Casting this restores 20% base mana and regenerates 5% of your max health.

Can be cast while moving.

abilities.name: Challenging Howl
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires Metamorphosis
Taunts the target to attack you, but has no effect if the target is already attacking you.

This spell can not miss.

abilities.name: Demon Charge
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires Metamorphosis
Charge an enemy, stunning it for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Immolation Aura
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires Metamorphosis
Ignites the area surrounds you, causing 221 Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Shadow Cleave
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires Metamorphosis
Inflicts 110 Shadow damage to an enemy target and nearby allies, affecting up to 3 targets.

abilities.name: Demonic Empowerment
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Grants the Warlock's summoned demon Empowerment.

Imp - Increases the Imp's spell critical strike chance by 20% for 30 sec.

Voidwalker - Increases the Voidwalker's health by 20%, and its threat generated from spells and attacks by 20% for 20 sec.

Succubus - Instantly vanishes, causing the Succubus to go into an improved Invisibility state. The vanish effect removes all stuns, snares and movement impairing effects from the Succubus.

Felhunter - Dispels all magical effects from the Felhunter.

Felguard - Increases the Felguard's attack speed by 20% and breaks all stun, snare and movement impairing effects and makes your Felguard immune to them for 15 sec.

abilities.name: Fel Domination
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter or Felguard Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

abilities.name: Metamorphosis
abilities.tooltipTemplate: You transform into a Demon for 30 sec. This form increases your armor by 600%, damage by 20%, reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 6% and reduces the duration of stun and snare effects by 50%. You gain some unique demon abilities in addition to your normal abilities. 3 minute cooldown.

abilities.name: Reign of Dread
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Requires
Surge into the air and scorch all enemies below with 1590 Shadowflame damage over 2.5 seconds. While airborne melee attacks against you have 60% increased chance to miss.

abilities.name: Soul Link
abilities.tooltipTemplate: When active, 20% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Felhunter, Felguard, or enslaved demon instead. That damage cannot be prevented. Lasts as long as the demon is active and controlled.

abilities.name: Summon Felguard
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Soul Shard

Summons a Felguard under the command of the Warlock.

abilities.name: Demon Lore
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Gather information about the target demon. The tooltip will display damage, health, armor and any special resistances. In addition, Demon Lore will reveal whether or not the creature is tameable and what abilities the tamed creature has.

abilities.name: Demonic Leap
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Leap into the air upon demonic wings, moving a short distance. If you reactivate it within 1 sec you will leap again.

abilities.name: Dismiss Demon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Dismiss your pet.

abilities.name: Enslave Demon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Begins enslaving a demon to be your companion. Your armor is reduced by 100% while you focus on taming the demon for 20 sec. If you lose the demon's attention for any reason, the enslaving process will fail. Once enslaved, the demon will be very unhappy and disloyal. Try feeding the pet immediately to make it happy.

abilities.name: Hand of Gul'dan
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Calls down a demonic meteor dealing Shadowflame damage to enemies within 5 yards and summons 4 Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target for 10 sec.

abilities.name: Nether Portal
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Tear open a portal to the Twisting Nether for 30 sec. Casting Shadow Bolt, Soul Fire or Incinerate summons a demon to fight for you. During Decimation your Soul Fire summons an additional demon.

abilities.name: Revive Demon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Revive your pet, returning it to life with 15% of its base health.

abilities.name: Soul Harvest
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Soul Shard

Increases your magic damage and your pets' damage by 15%. Lasts 6 sec, increased by 3 sec for each target afflicted by your Corruption, Curse of Agony and Immolate up to a maximum of 24 sec.

Does not stack with other similar effects.

abilities.name: Summon Demon
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Summons your Enslaved demon to you.

This abillity is usable while shapeshifted.

abilities.name: Unending Resolve
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Hardens your skin, reducing all damage taken by 30% and granting immunity to interrupt, silence, and pushback effects for 8 sec.

(60% while in Dark Apotheosis)

abilities.name: Hellfire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Ignites the area surrounding the caster, causing [V1] Fire damage to himself and [V1] Fire damage to all nearby enemies every 1 sec. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Immolate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Burns the enemy for [V1] Fire damage and then an additional [V2] Fire damage over 15 sec.

abilities.name: Incinerate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Deals [V1] Fire damage to your target and an additional [V2] Fire damage if the target is affected by an Immolate spell.

abilities.name: Rain of Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for [V1] Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Searing Pain
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Inflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing [V1] Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat.

abilities.name: Shadow Bolt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sends a shadowy bolt at the enemy, causing [V1] Shadow damage.

abilities.name: Shadowflame
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Targets in a cone in front of the caster take [V1] Shadow damage and an additional [V2] Fire damage over 8 sec.

abilities.name: Soul Fire
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Soul Shard

Burn the enemy's soul, causing [V1] Fire damage.

abilities.name: Chaos Bolt
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Sends a bolt of chaotic fire at the enemy, dealing [V1] Shadowflame damage. Chaos Bolt cannot be resisted, and pierces through all absorption effects.

abilities.name: Conflagrate
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Consumes an Immolate or Shadowflame effect on the enemy target to instantly deal damage equal to 60% of your Immolate or Shadowflame, and causes an additional 40% damage over until cancelled.

abilities.name: Shadowburn
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Soul Shard

Instantly blasts the target for [V1] Shadowflame damage. If the target dies within 5 sec of Shadowburn, and yields experience or honor, the caster gains a Soul Shard.

abilities.name: Shadowfury
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Shadowfury is unleashed, causing [V1] Shadow damage and stunning all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Bane of Havoc
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Curses the ground with a demonic bane, causing your Shadow Bolt, Incinerate, Soul Fire and Chaos Bolt spells to also strike targets marked with the bane for 50% of the damage dealt and have 15% increased critical strike chance. Lasts 15 sec.

abilities.name: Burning Rush
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
4% of base
Instant cast
Drains 3% of your maximum health per second to increase your movement speed by 50%. Movement-impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until cancelled.

abilities.name: Fire Storm
abilities.tooltipTemplate:
Calls down a fiery rain to burn enemies in the area of effect for (44+1.4 Points Per Level+SP*0.16)*6 Fire damage over 6 sec.

Scales with Rain of Fire modifiers.

abilities.name: Shadow Crash
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Hurl a bolt of slow-moving Shadow energy at the destination, dealing Shadow damage to enemies within 8 yards, pulling them towards the center of the explosion and slowing them by 70% for 3 sec.

abilities.name: Wild Felfire
abilities.school: Holy, Fire, Nature, Frost, Shadow, Arcane
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Fiery rain burns enemies in the area of effect for 84*8+SP*0.007+AP*0.0046 Chaos damage over 8 sec.
